title: A summary keeps a rank interval
hook: A compact quantile summary must keep track of what it no longer knows.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Compress a Greenwald-Khanna summary only while preserving its permitted rank-error interval.

misconception: Keeping evenly spaced observed values automatically bounds quantile rank error.
objective: Compress a Greenwald-Khanna summary only while preserving its permitted rank-error interval.

claims.text: Each tuple carries a minimum rank increment and additional rank uncertainty. An interior tuple merges right only when the combined increment plus the right tuple’s uncertainty fits the current error budget; endpoints are retained.
